title: S8: the Python gate run (both measurements, pyright baseline on click, packed-bundle footprint, README stated limits, ADR 0007 and 0008 follow-through)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 S8: the gate run of the native Python indexer on click 7.1.2 (held-out) and requests 3c7baaa under the committed scorer, through the shipped index path; pyright baseline on click with the committed ground truth; the packed-bundle footprint with the wasm resolvable from the installed tarball; README stated limits; ADR 0007 (third external) and ADR 0008 follow-through. The (a11) held-out integrity terms stand: the report states the informational click run at 3699733 (independent recall 67/80 = 0.8375, requests 57/65 = 0.8769, FAIL on both, NOT the gate run) preceded the (a11) ruling and the incidental grep over test/ that matched two python-gate lines (gate_score.py and its README, scoring-convention text about (a5) Q6, not ground truth; nothing opened or used); a gate FAIL is reported, never tuned against. The 0.1.0 tag and publish stay HELD.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a committed runner invokes the built dist/glyph.js over a clean checkout of click 7.1.2 and requests 3c7baaa from an empty cache, reads the resulting GlyphIndex, and feeds gate_score.py; it fails closed (non-zero, no score) on zero sites, fewer files than the scored package holds, a missing or empty index, or a failed build, proven both ways with a positive control (DEC-303 (a17) 1-2)

the gate runs once from the reviewed head, with glyph commit, sha256 of dist/glyph.js, repository commits, files and sites read, scorer output and input hashes recorded on the task and no ground-truth, scorer or pinned-hash change
the report states the (a11) informational-run and blind-rule disclosure sentences and the click verdict after (a11); a fresh blind sample is requested if click passes by 2 or fewer true sites
the packed tarball installed into an empty directory answers a Python command under node and the bundle footprint is recorded
README stated limits and ADR 0007 and 0008 follow-through are written and lore check is green
bun run check and lore check are green
